Hi Rajiv / Emily — answering the technical Qs below and adding a few implementation notes ahead of the workshop.

Region routing / data residency
- Yes — our policy engine supports region preference rules with hard constraints. Example (pseudo):
  policy: {
    route_by: "region",
    rules: [
      { if: "account.region == 'us'", prefer: ["us-west-1"], hard_block: ["eu-central-1"] },
      { if: "dr == true", fallback: ["eu-central-1"] }
    ]
  }
- For DR, you can configure automatic failover routing with a TTL and warm standby pools. We can limit what log data leaves the US per your data residency policy.

Fallback chains / latency & cost thresholds
- We support ordered fallback chains tied to latency and cost thresholds. Example trigger logic (plain text):
  - Primary: rdx-small (sub-50ms target). If p95 latency > 120ms OR cost_per_1000_tokens > $X then fail to rdx-medium.
  - Fallback: rdx-medium. If quality score (your eval metric) < Y then escalate to rdx-large.
- You can attach SLOs (p50/p95 latency) and budget ceilings to each tier.

Auth / SDK
- SDK supports both API keys and short-lived service tokens via our OAuth service account flow (recommended for server-to-server).
- Quickstart: pip install redwood-sdk; set REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN env var. We'll include a short demo in the workshop.

Embeddings / reranker pattern
- Typical flow we recommend:
  1) Ingest docs -> vector index (we support Pinecone/FAISS/S3-backed).
  2) Retrieve top-K by embedding similarity.
  3) Re-rank using a reranker model (cheap, high-throughput) or apply cross-encoder if precision required.
- We'll bring a sample eval notebook and cost comparisons to the session.

Security evidence
- Yes — we have a SOC2 evidence packet and an audit-log sample export. I'll attach redwood-soc2-evidence.zip to the HubSpot record after I confirm with Security.

Proposed workshop agenda (30–60m)
- 10m: Architecture & auth patterns (Dev)
- 15m: Routing policy examples + fallback walk-through (Marcus)
- 15m: Embeddings / reranker pattern (short demo)
- 10m: Q&A / next steps & handoffs

I'll hold Wed 8/20 @ 10:00am PT and Thu 8/21 @ 11:00am PT — which works better for your infra folks?
